name: Central Park
description: 843-acre park in the heart of Manhattan — lawns, lakes, and woodland.

name: Prospect Park
description: Brooklyn's answer to Central Park — 526 acres of meadow, forest, and lake.

name: Bryant Park
description: Small, densely-used green space behind the NYPL — great for a quick lunch-break reset.

name: The High Line
description: Elevated linear park built on a former rail line, threading through Chelsea.

name: Fort Tryon Park
description: Hilly, wooded park in Upper Manhattan with sweeping Hudson River views.

name: Flushing Meadows Corona Park
description: Queens' largest park — lakes, wetlands, and open lawns.

name: Van Cortlandt Park
description: The Bronx's sprawling park with forest trails and a freshwater lake.

name: Street Tree Cluster — West Village
description: Dense canopy of mature street trees along Bank & West 11th St, part of NYC's tree census.

name: Street Tree Cluster — Park Slope
description: Historic tree-lined blocks along 3rd St, one of the leafiest stretches in Brooklyn.

name: Brooklyn Botanic Garden
description: 52-acre living plant museum next to Prospect Park — cherry blossoms in spring.

name: 6B Garden
description: Hidden community garden tucked into the East Village — locals-only vibe, open weekends.

name: Liz Christy Community Garden
description: NYC's first community garden, est. 1973 — a quiet pocket on the Lower East Side.

name: Rat Rock (Central Park)
description: Manhattan schist boulder at 62nd St — the city's classic outdoor bouldering spot.

name: Rat Rock (Central Park) — North Face
description: Slightly steeper problems on the north side, less crowded on weekday mornings.

name: Jamaica Bay Wildlife Refuge
description: Migratory bird hotspot in Queens — 330+ species recorded, totally free to enter.

name: Prospect Park Lullwater
description: Quiet wooded waterway loop, one of the best low-key birdwatching walks in Brooklyn.

name: Inwood Hill Park Forest
description: Manhattan's last natural forest and salt marsh — feels nothing like the rest of the island.

name: Gantry Plaza State Park
description: Quiet East River waterfront in Long Island City with a killer Manhattan skyline view.
